theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_imp_lipschitz_jacobian_locality
theorems.statement: (∀ (k N N' : ℕ) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (G : Euclid k → Euclid N) (Λ : NNReal) (u : Euclid k), LipschitzWith Λ F → DifferentiableAt ℝ G u → Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin k => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (F ∘ G) u (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ (F ∘ G) u (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))) ≤ (Λ : ℝ) ^ k * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin k => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))))) ∧ ∀ (k N' : ℕ) (H H' : Euclid k → Euclid N') (B : Set (Euclid k)) (L L' : NNReal), LipschitzWith L H → LipschitzWith L' H' → MeasurableSet B → (∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict B), H u = H' u) → ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict B), fderiv ℝ H u = fderiv ℝ H' u
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
